pages.text: The $(d)Advanced Item Collector$() is an upgraded version of the $(l:irregular_implements:blocks/item_collector)Item Collector$(/l). Its collection volume is configurable, ranging from 0 to 10 blocks in each direction.$(br2)Each axis (X/Y/Z) can be configured independently, as well.
Additionally, you can insert an $(l:irregular_implements:filter/item_filter)Item Filter$(/l), and it will only collect items that match the filter.
